thread:
sarah_sdr: Quick one — Zenith wants a POC next month. They asked for 30% off hosted API for a 3-month pilot + dedicated bursting (estimated $150k list over 3 months). Can we approve?

Tom_SE: Are they asking for hosted discounted usage only or reserved committed Dedicated capacity too?

sarah_sdr: Both. Pilot starts hosted, but they want optional Dedicated for month 2 if perf looks good. Pitch was: 30% off usage + 20% off any Dedicated commit.

Tom_SE: Technically we can support. Need to confirm capacity and SLA for dedicated bursts. Also: security review still pending (they're in fintech).

Raj_deals: Put numbers pls. I need ARR equivalence and discount impact.

Sarah_SDR: Rough math: list = $150k over 3 months; 30% off => $45k discount. If they convert to Dedicated and commit $50k/mo at 20% off => $10k/mo discount.

Emma_Finance: 30% on hosted is sizable for a pilot. For deals this size we normally require a pilot commitment or proof milestones. Do we have an exec sponsor?

Sarah_SDR: Exec sponsor is Zenith VP of AI (cc'd in email). They said 'proof of latency/cost gains' is the goal. No financial commit for hosted pilot.

Raj_deals: OK. Two questions for deal desk: 1) Approve one-time pilot promo (30% hosted) with no commit? 2) If customer converts to Dedicated within 90 days, allow 20% off first 6 months of committed rate? Approvals contingent on security OK and legal T&Cs.

Liz_Legal: We'll need to add a pilot addendum: liability cap, data handling clause, and an exit clause after 90 days. Also check export controls for zenith region.

Approvals-bot: New approval request created: PR-1765004321. Required approvers: finance (emma_finance), deals (raj_deals), legal (liz_legal). Link: https://redwood.internal/approvals/PR-1765004321

Emma_Finance: I can greenlight the pilot promo only if we include a $25k refundable pilot deposit or a commitment to evaluate defined KPIs. Otherwise margin hit is too high.

Raj_deals: Counter-proposal: Approve 30% hosted pilot only with a $25k deposit (refundable on KPI pass) + 20% off Dedicated first 3 months (not 6) if they commit within 60 days. If legal + security sign off, I can approve.

Tom_SE: From an engineering view, we can scope the dedicated bursting but need to ensure canary routing and fallbacks configured. I'll add a short SOW snippet to the approval: ```- Pilot scope: hosted API + optional Dedicated burst
- Perf targets: p95 < 250ms for inference
- KPI: 10k high-quality tok/day for 30 days
```

Liz_Legal: Sounds reasonable. I need time to draft the pilot addendum. ETA EOD tomorrow.

Sarah_SDR: Sounds like a plan. I'll update the approver thread and ping the VP for the deposit signoff. Thanks all :rocket:

Raj_deals: Marking tentative APPROVE pending deposit + legal/security. Will update PR-1765004321 after docs come in. :white_check_mark:
